import heapq

class MinimumCostFlow:
    def __init__(self, node_count):
        self.size = node_count
        self.edges_info = []
        self.adjacency = [[] for _ in range(node_count)]

    def connect(self, src, dst, capacity, weight):
        idx = len(self.edges_info)
        self.edges_info.append((src, len(self.adjacency[src])))
        self.adjacency[src].append(self.Edge(dst, len(self.adjacency[dst]), capacity, weight))
        self.adjacency[dst].append(self.Edge(src, len(self.adjacency[src]) - 1, 0, -weight))
        return idx

    class Link:
        def __init__(self, origin, destination, capacity, flow, weight):
            self.origin = origin
            self.destination = destination
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.weight = weight

    def retrieve_link(self, index):
        source, pos = self.edges_info[index]
        forward = self.adjacency[source][pos]
        backward = self.adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev]
        return self.Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight)

    def all_links(self):
        output = []
        for idx in range(len(self.edges_info)):
            source, pos = self.edges_info[idx]
            forward = self.adjacency[source][pos]
            backward = self.adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev]
            output.append(self.Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight))
        return output

    def _potential_update(self, source, target):
        self.distances = [4294967295] * self.size
        self.parents = [-1] * self.size
        self.parent_edges = [-1] * self.size
        self.marked = [False] * self.size
        queue = [source]
        self.distances[source] = 0
        while queue:
            current = heapq.heappop(queue) & 4294967295
            if self.marked[current]:
                continue
            self.marked[current] = True
            if current == target:
                break
            for idx in range(len(self.adjacency[current])):
                edge = self.adjacency[current][idx]
                if self.marked[edge.destination] or edge.capacity == 0:
                    continue
                adjusted_cost = edge.weight - self.potential[edge.destination] + self.potential[current]
                if self.distances[edge.destination] > self.distances[current] + adjusted_cost:
                    self.distances[edge.destination] = self.distances[current] + adjusted_cost
                    self.parents[edge.destination] = current
                    self.parent_edges[edge.destination] = idx
                    heapq.heappush(queue, ((self.distances[edge.destination] << 32) + edge.destination))
        if not self.marked[target]:
            return False
        for node in range(self.size):
            if not self.marked[node]:
                continue
            self.potential[node] -= self.distances[target] - self.distances[node]
        return True

    def pareto_frontier(self, source, target, max_flow=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.size
        self.distances = [4294967295] * self.size
        self.parents = [-1] * self.size
        self.parent_edges = [-1] * self.size
        self.marked = [False] * self.size
        current_flow = 0
        total_weight = 0
        last_weight = -1
        frontier = [(current_flow, total_weight)]
        while current_flow < max_flow:
            if not self._potential_update(source, target):
                break
            bottleneck = max_flow - current_flow
            node = target
            while node != source:
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, self.adjacency[self.parents[node]][self.parent_edges[node]].capacity)
                node = self.parents[node]
            node = target
            while node != source:
                edge = self.adjacency[self.parents[node]][self.parent_edges[node]]
                edge.capacity -= bottleneck
                self.adjacency[node][edge.rev].capacity += bottleneck
                node = self.parents[node]
            reduced_cost = -self.potential[source]
            current_flow += bottleneck
            total_weight += bottleneck * reduced_cost
            if last_weight == reduced_cost:
                frontier.pop()
            frontier.append((current_flow, total_weight))
            last_weight = reduced_cost
        return frontier

    def min_cost_flow(self, source, target, max_flow=4294967295):
        return self.pareto_frontier(source, target, max_flow)[-1]

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, destination, reverse, capacity, weight):
            self.destination = destination
            self.reverse = reverse
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.weight = weight

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class MinimumCostFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int destination;
        int rev;
        int capacity;
        int weight;
        Edge(int d, int r, int c, int w) : destination(d), rev(r), capacity(c), weight(w) {}
    };

    struct Link {
        int origin;
        int destination;
        int capacity;
        int flow;
        int weight;
        Link(int o, int d, int cap, int fl, int w) : origin(o), destination(d), capacity(cap), flow(fl), weight(w) {}
    };

    int size;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edges_info;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adjacency;

    MinimumCostFlow(int node_count) : size(node_count) {
        adjacency.resize(node_count);
    }

    int connect(int src, int dst, int capacity, int weight) {
        int idx = edges_info.size();
        edges_info.push_back(make_pair(src, adjacency[src].size()));
        adjacency[src].push_back(Edge(dst, adjacency[dst].size(), capacity, weight));
        adjacency[dst].push_back(Edge(src, adjacency[src].size() - 1, 0, -weight));
        return idx;
    }

    Link retrieve_link(int index) {
        int source = edges_info[index].first;
        int pos = edges_info[index].second;
        Edge& forward = adjacency[source][pos];
        Edge& backward = adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev];
        return Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight);
    }

    vector<Link> all_links() {
        vector<Link> output;
        for (int idx = 0; idx < edges_info.size(); idx++) {
            int source = edges_info[idx].first;
            int pos = edges_info[idx].second;
            Edge& forward = adjacency[source][pos];
            Edge& backward = adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev];
            output.push_back(Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight));
        }
        return output;
    }

    vector<int> potential;
    vector<int> distances;
    vector<int> parents;
    vector<int> parent_edges;
    vector<bool> marked;

    bool _potential_update(int source, int target) {
        distances = vector<int>(size, 4294967295);
        parents = vector<int>(size, -1);
        parent_edges = vector<int>(size, -1);
        marked = vector<bool>(size, false);
        priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> queue;
        distances[source] = 0;
        queue.push(make_pair(0, source));
        
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            int current = queue.top().second;
            int dist = queue.top().first;
            queue.pop();
            
            if (marked[current]) continue;
            marked[current] = true;
            
            if (current == target) break;
            
            for (int idx = 0; idx < adjacency[current].size(); idx++) {
                Edge& edge = adjacency[current][idx];
                if (marked[edge.destination] || edge.capacity == 0) continue;
                
                int adjusted_cost = edge.weight - potential[edge.destination] + potential[current];
                if (distances[edge.destination] > distances[current] + adjusted_cost) {
                    distances[edge.destination] = distances[current] + adjusted_cost;
                    parents[edge.destination] = current;
                    parent_edges[edge.destination] = idx;
                    queue.push(make_pair(distances[edge.destination], edge.destination));
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!marked[target]) return false;
        
        for (int node = 0; node < size; node++) {
            if (!marked[node]) continue;
            potential[node] -= distances[target] - distances[node];
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<pair<int, long long>> pareto_frontier(int source, int target, int max_flow = 4294967295) {
        potential = vector<int>(size, 0);
        distances = vector<int>(size, 4294967295);
        parents = vector<int>(size, -1);
        parent_edges = vector<int>(size, -1);
        marked = vector<bool>(size, false);
        
        int current_flow = 0;
        long long total_weight = 0;
        int last_weight = -1;
        vector<pair<int, long long>> frontier;
        frontier.push_back(make_pair(current_flow, total_weight));
        
        while (current_flow < max_flow) {
            if (!_potential_update(source, target)) break;
            
            int bottleneck = max_flow - current_flow;
            int node = target;
            while (node != source) {
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, adjacency[parents[node]][parent_edges[node]].capacity);
                node = parents[node];
            }
            
            node = target;
            while (node != source) {
                Edge& edge = adjacency[parents[node]][parent_edges[node]];
                edge.capacity -= bottleneck;
                adjacency[node][edge.rev].capacity += bottleneck;
                node = parents[node];
            }
            
            int reduced_cost = -potential[source];
            current_flow += bottleneck;
            total_weight += (long long)bottleneck * reduced_cost;
            
            if (last_weight == reduced_cost && !frontier.empty()) {
                frontier.pop_back();
            }
            frontier.push_back(make_pair(current_flow, total_weight));
            last_weight = reduced_cost;
        }
        return frontier;
    }

    pair<int, long long> min_cost_flow(int source, int target, int max_flow = 4294967295) {
        vector<pair<int, long long>> frontier = pareto_frontier(source, target, max_flow);
        return frontier.back();
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a1, a2, a3;
    int b1, b2, b3;
    cin >> a1 >> a2 >> a3;
    cin >> b1 >> b2 >> b3;

    MinimumCostFlow g(8);
    g.connect(0, 1, a1, 0);
    g.connect(0, 2, a2, 0);
    g.connect(0, 3, a3, 0);
    g.connect(4, 7, b1, 0);
    g.connect(5, 7, b2, 0);
    g.connect(6, 7, b3, 0);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
            int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
            g.connect(i, j, INT_MAX, cost);
        }
    }

    pair<int, long long> result = g.min_cost_flow(0, 7);
    long long ans1 = result.second;
    int ans2 = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1);
    
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
